# Security

If you discover a security issue in Veyro, please report it responsibly.

**Preferred:** [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/WtekSupport/veyro/security/advisories/new) (private report).

Include steps to reproduce, affected version, and impact if known. We will acknowledge receipt and work on a fix before public disclosure when appropriate.

Do not open public issues for exploitable vulnerabilities.
